Probables
National Academy, Bengaluru. 6:58 AM. Thirty players in identical navy kit. Nobody is talking.
My name is Kabir Joshi. Some of you have big contracts. Some of you have big followings. I have a stopwatch.
Thirty of you. Fifteen seats on the plane. Most of you are tourists. I'm going to find out which ones by lunch.
{first}. Rajgarh. The PCL boy.
Your highlights have two million views. There are no cameras in my nets. Pads on. Net three.
Every head turns. Somebody whispers "chaiwala". Somebody laughs.
At the end of net three, a lanky boy with a thin moustache is spinning a red ball in his fingers. He looks like he's about to apologise.
Sorry in advance, bhai. Kabir sir said bowl at your head.
Net Three
Imran Shaikh. 145 clicks and no mercy. Kabir Sir is timing your feet, not your shots. Survive four balls.
STILL STANDING
Kabir clicks the stopwatch. Says nothing.
BOWLED
Middle stump is twelve feet away.
Again. Same four balls. This time without looking scared.
I wasn't scared. ...I was a little scared.
Two million views. One ball.
Back of the queue. Watch everybody. Learn something.
Room 213. Two beds, one ice bath, and a roommate unpacking forty packets of banana chips.
Amma made them. She thinks Bengaluru has no food.
My father has a fishing boat in Kerala. Half a boat. My uncle has the other half. If I make this squad, I buy the other half.
"I'll buy the chips if you teach me that bouncer."
Make a friend.
"You know only one of us can win this, right?"
Keep your distance.
Send ₹5,000 to his mother for the trip.
Quietly. He'll never know it was you.
Deal. But the bouncer costs extra. Chai. Your chai. I heard it's famous.
He talks for an hour about the sea. You fall asleep somewhere around the monsoon.
...Right. Yes. Of course.
He turns off his lamp without another word.
2:40 AM. A sound wakes you. Imran is sitting on the edge of the ice bath, biting a towel so he doesn't make noise.
His left shin is swollen like a cricket ball.
Don't. Please. If Kabir sir knows, I'm on the first train home.
It's nothing. Just a knock. Please, bhai.
A stress fracture can end a fast bowler's career. Telling Kabir Sir will end his week.
